description: This file defines API endpoints for Google Endpoints integration in a FastAPI project. It handles content generation, token counting, interactions (create, retrieve, delete, cancel), and streaming responses. It relies on external modules for request processing, authentication, and interaction routing.

classes.name: TokenCountDetailsResponse
classes.description: Response model for token counting, including total tokens and detailed prompt token counts.

classes.name: ProxyBaseLLMRequestProcessing
classes.description: Class responsible for processing the base LLM request, handling common pre- and post-processing.

methods.name: google_generate_content( request: Request, model_name: str, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles content generation requests from Google endpoints, calling internal content generation router.

methods.name: google_stream_generate_content( request: Request, model_name: str, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles streaming content generation requests, returning streaming responses if applicable.

methods.name: google_count_tokens(request: Request, model_name: str)
methods.description: Counts tokens in provided contents, returns token count details.

methods.name: create_interaction( request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Creates a new interaction using Google's Interactions API.

methods.name: get_interaction( request: Request, interaction_id: str, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Retrieves an existing interaction by interaction ID.

methods.name: delete_interaction( request: Request, interaction_id: str, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Deletes an existing interaction by ID.

methods.name: cancel_interaction( request: Request, interaction_id: str, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing interaction by ID.
